summary: Oriental Culture Holding LTD filed a Form 6-K reporting its entry into a Subscription Agreement to acquire a 75% limited partnership interest in Jade Cove, L.P. for US$15 million. This is the registrant making an investment as a limited partner, not a business combination or acquisition of a company. The filing does not trigger a special situation such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring; it is a routine investment arrangement. No deal terms like price per share or premium are applicable. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of a subscription agreement.
